service.name: Student Scholarship Application
service.label: GovGuide Demo
service.description: Apply for financial assistance through a guided demonstration workflow.
service.audience: Students who want to understand a scholarship-style digital service workflow.
service.demo_notice: Prototype demonstration — not an official government portal.

documents.name: Student ID
documents.description: A school or college identity document.

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.description: A document showing the family's annual income.

documents.name: Bank details
documents.description: The bank account details requested by this fictional demo.

documents.name: Photograph
documents.description: A recent passport-style photograph for the demo.

fields.label: Full Name
fields.help: Enter your name as you would like it to appear on the demonstration application.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.help: Enter your date of birth using the date picker.

fields.label: State
fields.help: Choose the state you want to use for this fictional demonstration.

fields.label: Category
fields.help: Choose one option for this demonstration. This prototype does not decide eligibility.

fields.label: Annual Family Income
fields.help: The total amount of money earned by your family in one year.

fields.label: Bank Account Number
fields.help: Enter a fictional account number for the demonstration. Do not use a real bank account number.

fields.label: Photograph
fields.help: Choose any non-sensitive demo image from your computer. The prototype only records the file name and does not upload it.

fields.label: Income Certificate
fields.help: Choose a fictional demo certificate file if you have one. The prototype only records the file name and does not upload or verify it.

service.simple_text_demo: Applicants shall furnish documentary evidence substantiating annual household income.
